name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: TRIGGER-SELECTOR BUILD (v3): confirmed the same-window-resend bug (see 0.4.36's changelog) also fires from a *manual* resend, not just this add-on's former auto-retry -- a user who sees the failure dialog (left visible by the sendError trigger) and clicks Send again on the same window hits the identical uncleared-mCerts corruption. Adds a warning (not a block) on any GenericSendMessage() call on a window that has already seen one failure, via Services.prompt.alert(), telling the user to close and reopen instead of resending from the same window. Also restores a dedup guard (__certCleanupHandlingFailure) on the sendError trigger: ComposeProcessDone was observed firing twice for one real failure again (lost when this build's predecessor was rewritten from the v0.4.35 architecture), causing a redundant second cleanup+reinit pass -- harmless but noisy.
